learnedConstraints.finding: Centered nonlinear bass outperformed chorus-heavy low-end width.
learnedConstraints.evidence: warm-density stereo correlation remained close to the reference while preserving high timbre similarity
learnedConstraints.nextAction: Keep sub and bass-center recipes mono-compatible; create width above the bass layer.

learnedConstraints.finding: Dark bounded ambience added depth more reliably than maximum width.
learnedConstraints.evidence: focused-depth and dimensional-detail achieved strong timbre but lost substantial stereo-fit score
learnedConstraints.nextAction: Use dark rooms and plates on selected layers; reserve wide echoes for sparse phrases.

learnedConstraints.finding: More processing stages did not imply a better result.
learnedConstraints.evidence: the 18-stage warm-density variant beat the 21-stage dimensional-detail variant
learnedConstraints.nextAction: Promote recipes by measured A/B outcome, not chain length.

learnedConstraints.finding: Factory mastering presets must demonstrate a dynamics improvement before retention.
learnedConstraints.evidence: Glue Make It Loud changed level by only 0.25 dB and left crest factor effectively unchanged
learnedConstraints.nextAction: Reject no-op mastering stages and solve loudness with a separately tested real Ableton chain.
